known_limitations: Commodity ETF qfq series are vendor-reconstructed proxies, not continuous futures total-return series.
The commodity-only state applies only to 2026 months in this sample, so the recent improvement has limited history.
The screen reuses R344 cached stock curves and therefore inherits its stock and industry data limitations.
negative_knowledge: A commodity trend alternative is a useful defensive diversifier: 2x/5x MDD and recent-year return improved versus the gold-only proxy.
The improvement came with lower annual return and a still-negative 2022 segment; 5x net-profit concentration remained above every cap.
Do not scan moving-average windows, commodity weights, basket membership or state thresholds; this line is closed.
